strings.ui.debug.title: DEBUG OPTIONS
strings.ui.debug.items.help: Add any item to the inventory.
strings.ui.debug.maps.help: Go to a map, choose the starting map.
strings.ui.debug.spawn.help: Put a character in front of Harry.
strings.ui.debug.infinite_ammo.help: Guns you own fire without spending rounds.
strings.ui.debug.heal_items.help: Adds 3 drinks, 3 first aid kits, 3 ampoules.
strings.ui.debug.give.help: Adds the picked item to the inventory.
strings.ui.debug.goto_map.help: Picking a map starts a game there.
strings.ui.debug.restart_map.help: Returns Harry to the start of this map.
strings.ui.debug.start_map.help: The map a New Game starts on.
strings.ui.debug.spawn_category.help: Group of characters; the Character list shows this group.
strings.ui.debug.spawn_state.help: Starting behaviour state, -1 is the default.
strings.ui.debug.spawn_ai.help: Auto: the map's AI when the map has the character, else its own or the fallback AI. Full: its own AI anywhere. Fallback: the generic AI. None: a statue.
strings.ui.debug.spawn_preview_on.help: The picked character turns in a panel beside the menu; Spawn puts it in the world.
strings.ui.debug.spawn_now.help: Puts the picked character in the world in front of Harry.
strings.ui.debug.free_camera.help: Fly the camera around the map.
strings.ui.debug.log_camera.help: Writes the current camera to the log.
strings.ui.debug.flag.help: Pick the flag to read or change.
strings.ui.debug.flag_value.help: Sets or clears the picked flag.
strings.ui.debug.fps_display.help: Frame counter corner, saved to config.
strings.ui.debug.profiler.help: Frame time and 1% low, CPU, GPU, RAM, VRAM and draw calls next to the FPS counter; saved to config.
strings.ui.debug.perf_record.help: Frame times, hitches and GPU pass times into the perfrec folder beside the game until switched off.
strings.ui.debug.log_position.help: Writes map, room and position to the log.
